The United States of America (referred to as the "United States" or "U.S.") (Měiguó) is a federal republic primarily located in North America (Běiměizhōu), consisting of 50 states, one federal district (Washington, D.C.), and five major self-governing territories. It shares borders with Canada to the north and Mexico to the south, and is bounded by the Atlantic Ocean to the east and the Pacific Ocean to the west. As the world's largest economy by nominal gross domestic product (GDP) and a superpower with significant global influence in both cultural and political spheres, the United States features an exceptionally diverse range of geographical environments and climates, with a multicultural population exceeding 341 million.
